newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Canadian Prairie primary elevators tightened to 33 percent in the week ended June 8 while railcar unloads fell short of targeted levels, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
The 33 percent average vacancy in Prairie elevators was down from 35 percent on June 2, the Board said.
Manitoba had the most space at 42 percent, followed by Alberta at 35 percent and Saskatchewan at 31 percent.
Vancouver unloaded 3,016 railcars versus the 3,300 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 900 railcars versus the 1,300 target.
Thunder Bay unloaded 3,256 railcars versus the 3,220 target.
